samples.rationale: The blank-value rule is lifted into an immutable package-private `SpecialtyFilter` record (SpecialtyFilter.java) testable without the web layer, keeping the new rule out of the controller and adding a genuine unit test — exactly what the pyramid section asks. Repository derived queries state case-insensitivity in the query, with the cache decision reasoned in an ADR. Deductions: `VetController.pageLinkSpecialty` encodes a Thymeleaf null-vs-empty-collection quirk into the model contract (Collection<String> attribute), a subtle template coupling only comments and system-design.md guard; `findPaginated`'s inline comment restates the code. New `VetControllerTests` stubs (findDistinctBySpecialtiesNameIgnoreCase given(...)) extend mock-framework usage without the conscious-exception rationale, and `theSpecialtyFilterShouldBeEqualByValue` asserts record-generated equality. Documentation is thorough: PRD, NG-9 narrowing, superseded list, open questions, vocabulary, contracts, threat and defect tables all move together.

The blank-value rule is lifted out of the controller into an immutable, package-private `SpecialtyFilter` record testable without the web layer, and matching moves into `VetRepository.findDistinctBySpecialtiesNameIgnoreCase` with an ADR justifying leaving it uncached — right layer, right seams. Docs move everywhere the change touches: NG-9 narrowed, REQ-VET-003/004 minted with REQ-VET-002 left withdrawn, the stale "route serves no requirement" defect row deleted, contracts, threat table, open question 5, and vocabulary updated. Tests are behavior-named with meaningful constants and a factory. Deductions: the model attribute `specialty` holds a `Collection<String>` purely for Thymeleaf's null handling (documented but easy to misread), and controller tests extend Mockito stubbing and assert escaped HTML substrings (`page=2&specialty=`), while `theSpecialtyFilterShouldBeEqualByValue` bundles two concerns around a bare `""`.

The blank-value rule is lifted into an immutable package-private record (SpecialtyFilter.java:31-46) and unit-tested without the web layer, so no new business rule lands in VetController; the repository gains derived queries left uncached with the reason recorded. Small frictions: `SpecialtyFilter` carries a suffix the naming table's value-object row does not sanction and never enters ubiquitous-language.md; the `narrows() ? filtered : unfiltered` branch is duplicated in both handlers (VetController.java:84-88, 97-100); and the model attribute named `specialty` actually holds a Collection (pageLinkSpecialty), a Thymeleaf workaround that is documented but still surprising. Tests are behavior-named and constant-driven, though `theSpecialtyFilterShouldBeEqualByValue` bundles two concerns and new Mockito stubbing is added without the conscious-exception rationale the principles ask for. Documentation is thorough: two ADRs, PRD non-goal narrowing, REQ-VET-003/004, superseded note, contracts, threat table, and the retired known-defect row all move together.
